item.title: 企业知识与 Ontology
item.summary: 企业知识底座正在从文档检索或静态知识图谱升级为“可执行知识控制面”：以业务对象、指标、关系、规则、权限、动作、谱系和记忆生命周期共同约束 Agent。Palantir 已给出纵向一体化的生产样板；Microsoft、Databricks、SAP 正把 ontology 内嵌到数据与业务套件，Snowflake 偏指标语义，AWS/Google 偏图检索。市场处于 pilot，因为跨域绑定新鲜度、schema 演化、评估回归、人工放行和单位成功动作经济仍不可比。

synthesis.outlook_12_36m: 未来 12–36 个月，Ontology 不会作为孤立图数据库胜出，而会与语义指标、数据目录、身份权限、事件流、评估和动作 API 合并。赢家需要持续绑定源系统、保留证据谱系、支持 schema 演化与版本回滚，并用生产动作成功率和单位成功动作成本证明价值。
synthesis.strategic_summary: 企业知识底座正在从文档检索或静态知识图谱升级为“可执行知识控制面”：以业务对象、指标、关系、规则、权限、动作、谱系和记忆生命周期共同约束 Agent。Palantir 已给出纵向一体化的生产样板；Microsoft、Databricks、SAP 正把 ontology 内嵌到数据与业务套件，Snowflake 偏指标语义，AWS/Google 偏图检索。市场处于 pilot，因为跨域绑定新鲜度、schema 演化、评估回归、人工放行和单位成功动作经济仍不可比。

evidence.source_quote:
从落地的角度上说，结论：**如果你的核心问题是“我的数据在多个系统里，我想关联查询”，Neo4j + 规则引擎足够。只有当你同时面临语义混乱、操作割裂的强需求，并且有足够的预算和决心进行深度实施时，Palantir Ontology 才是一个值得考虑的选择** 。
先说这两个方案的界定： 传统知识图谱通常侧重于数据关联和查询（读），Palantir ontology通过Action Types实现了业务操作的闭环（写）。
**传统知识图谱（Neo4j + ETL）的架构本质** ：数据必须物理搬运到图库，存在三个隐性成本：**同步延迟** ：ETL 通常是 T+1 或小时级，业务状态不一致；**Schema 漂移** ：源系统字段变更，图谱模型需要同步调整；**写回困难** ：规则引擎触发后，如何把结果写回 ERP/CRM？需要额外开发反向 ETL。
**Palantir Ontology 的架构本质** ：Ontology 是逻辑层，不强制数据物理迁移。Foundry 连接器实时同步变更（同步ETL），Function 直接操作逻辑对象，变更通过连接器同步写回源系统。
**step3. 定义 Action Type** ，Action Type 可以直接写回源系统。例如定义一个 TransferInventory 动作：

evidence.source_quote:
即使用上全世界最好的大模型，只要公司内部的笔记、通话、流程散得一塌糊涂，AI输出的还是垃圾。
现在很多企业的所谓AI系统，检索靠人记文档在哪，过时的SOP和实时的CRM数据权重一样，所有人能看所有内容——这种AI demo时看着惊艳，真到干活全是废的。
ericosiu团队重新梳理了核心逻辑：**记忆是原材料，检索是操作系统层** ，真正能用的"公司大脑"不是存储柜，而是一套能把零散信息转成有效工作的智能层，核心分为5个关键层级：
AI不需要全公司的历史，只需要当前任务最相关的几条上下文：写外发邮件要ICP、报价、异议库、过往活动数据、品牌语气、当前活动目标；做销售 pipeline 审核要 deal 阶段变化、停滞客户、近期通话笔记、异议、下一步动作、CRM实时数据。很多AI demo好看是因为手动喂了精准上下文，生产环境崩了就是没做检索层。
营销AI不能看HR隐私，内容AI不能看客户财务，销售AI不能看所有内部高管笔记——尤其是 agency 类公司，权限边界没做好要么泄密，要么把AI废成只能说废话的摆设。目标不是一个没墙的大大脑，而是给每个工作流配一个权限合适的小大脑。
这是让系统真正越用越好用的核心：人类每次修正AI的内容，都要自动变成未来的规则——比如AI用了生硬的话术，就更新语气规则；引用了不安全的案例，就更新来源规则；漏了CRM风险信号，就更新 pipeline 扫描规则。没有这个，就是天天给AI擦屁股；有了这个，每次修正都是给整个操作系统做训练。
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: 企业AI生产失效不仅来自流程与本体未对齐，还来自检索、权限、真相层和反馈机制缺失。
Snowflake 10-Q 用于比较语义层平台消费与专业服务经济，不把 ontology 单独归因。

evidence.source_quote: Data binding connects your ontology's definitions (including entity types, properties, and relationships) to concrete data living in OneLake, including lakehouse tables, eventhouse streams, and Power BI semantic models. A data binding describes data types, identity keys, how columns map to properties, and how keys map to relationships across multiple data sources. By enabling schema evolution rules, data quality checks (based on things like nullability, ranges, and uniqueness), and provenance at the concept layer, bindings turn raw rows and events into governed business objects. Data binding ensures your data has consistent meaning, follows the same rules, and tracks where it came from across different data sources.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Microsoft Fabric Ontology 文档同时给出共享语义能力与 preview、手工刷新等边界。

evidence.source_quote: Connected data foundation→ When General Mills and Palantir began their partnership in 2019, they built a connected data foundation on the Palantir Ontology by integrating 200 master and operational data tables to serve as a single source of truth to accelerate future use cases.End-to-end logistics flow (ELF) → Project ELF, an intelligent execution system build on Palantir AIP, consumes constraints, capacity, and network cost across the General Mills supply chain in real-time– surveying across thousands of orders and surfacing recommendations to mitigate disruptions or flag potential cost savings. AI-powered recommendations → Over 70% of recommendations made by ELF are accepted by a human-in-the-loop – powering speed to value and translating into $40,000/day in savings, or $14M annually.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: General Mills 客户材料核验知识/本体底座进入大规模供应链生产网络。

evidence.source_quote: LLM-powered Product Matching → Using Palantir AIP, Aramark leveraged large language models to match products with similar names, achieving a 99% confidence level in 30% of initial matches. The business went on to automate matching for products with >99% confidence, drastically reducing the need for manual interaction.Full Data Lineage → Through utilizing the Ontology, Aramark was able to link products from buy side to sell side, creating a full data lineage, enabling atomic-level detailed financial and consumer analysis. Data Classification → Aramark leveraged the Classification Manager to auto-classify data elements like meal types and service locations – supplementing auto-classifications with manual processes for 1% of products, and automating classification for the remaining 99%, driving significant time savings and deep levels of analysis. What’s Next → Aramark's journey with Palantir is ongoing, with plans for integration of unstructured data to better understand the voice of the customer, and the creation of a full digital twin to predict and simulate future operations.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Aramark 客户材料核验 Ontology、数据血缘和产品匹配进入生产流程。

evidence.source_quote: This matters because many agent apps fail for a simple reason: they don’t have the context they need. Data is scattered across systems, permissions are complex, and each integration becomes a one-off project. Frontier makes it easier for applications to access the business context they need (with the right controls), so they can work inside real workflows from day one. For enterprises, that means faster rollouts without a long integration cycle every time.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: OpenAI Frontier 官方定义开放企业语义层、上下文、身份权限和执行环境。

evidence.source_quote: All items together: Semantic models deliver trusted KPIs; ontology (preview) defines shared business language for those KPIs; Graph powers relationship and impact analysis; plan turns insights into coordinated actions; and data and operations agents provide intelligent, concept-aware interactions over live and historical data.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Fabric IQ 官方定义 ontology、语义模型、Graph 与 agent 动作的分层关系。
